MODULE_LIBRARY.NoExtension: Module Library: no browser extension found. Install it to manage this world's modules from the Setup screen. This notice appears once.
MODULE_LIBRARY.Outdated: Module Library: the companion module and the browser extension use different protocol versions. Update the older one.

Apply.Title: Module Library: apply module changes
Apply.Intro: Changes queued from the Setup screen for this world. Applying reloads the world once.
Apply.NoChange: No change: the world already matches.
Apply.Dependents: Still needed by modules that stay
Apply.AcceptConflicts: Enable these modules despite the declared conflicts
Apply.RemoveDependents: Also disable the modules that need a removed one
Apply.Cancelled: Module Library: nothing was changed, because a queued change was cancelled on the Setup screen meanwhile.
Apply.Reviewed: Module Library: applying the module changes you reviewed on the Setup screen. The world reloads once.
Apply.NeedConflictConsent: Module Library: confirm the conflicts to apply, or choose Not now.
Apply.NeedDependentsChoice: Module Library: choose to disable the dependent modules too, or choose Not now.
